claim: An audit finding alone did not remove an unsafe integration fallback; durable repair restricted the permitted operation.
topology: Seven vertical stages reconstruct the control gap, observed broken hybrid, and durable repair.
bw_encoding: Dashed warning box; solid repair box; text identifies each role.
redesign: Corrected the integration outcome: incompatible edits disabled merge automation. Seven compact vertical stages distinguish warning-only evaluation from the durable removal of the unsafe fallback. Caption identifies a control-gap reconstruction rather than a verified execution trace. Native and SVG proofs visually inspected; pending author approval.
alt: Control-gap reconstruction, not an execution trace. The integration fallback retries a rebase conflict with -X theirs. An audit detects the dangerous automatic resolution and evaluates it as unsafe, but only warns and leaves the fallback available. Observed incompatible edits made merge automation fail to load. The durable repair removed the retry and requires escalation for conflicts without a sanctioned resolution.
